identifier_rows.FK10: OPEN **[v1.37] The owner's ruling of 2026-10-09 (relayed by the SM seat, its relay §49): keep FK10 open.** No postulate is added for the unit of end data at the weave's cusp; results stay "given Λ"; revisit when a forcing is found or a physical end mechanism at the cusp is derived. The question carried: does the principle force one unit of end data at the weave's cusp (the SM seat's W45, W46)? **[v1.38] Sharpened (B1629): nothing the principle forces visits the weave's cusp.** The tick LR is the unique lowest closed geodesic of the weave (top √5/2; the next is √2, B482's Markov values); the clock's word, read as moves, stays below height 2.3; under the weave's uniform measure the fraction of letters in a run of length ≥ k, the time spent deep in the cusp, is (k+1)/2^k at every length, with no atom. So the unit of end data that W45 and W46 need for a chiral three is not dynamical: if it is forced, it is forced as a boundary datum, by a physical end mechanism or a postulate. **[v1.39] THE CUSP'S UNIT, A TAGGED WORKING POSTULATE (the owner's decision of 2026-10-09, made directly to main; it supersedes the relayed 'keep FK10 open').** One unit of end data at the weave's cusp is adopted as a working postulate, as Λ is: results that use it carry "given the unit". By the SM seat's W46, it gives the weave's own surface M₁,₂ a four-dimensional index of ±3 at the natural puncture conditions (±1 at the middle ones). So, given Λ and the unit, the chiral three is an index, and FK11's earning condition is met conditionally. The three is not chosen (it is dim T); only the unit's existence is postulated, and B1629 shows it cannot be supplied by the principle's dynamics. Revisit when the audit lane derives an end mechanism at the cusp, or a forcing is found. **[v1.44] Scoped (Review 63, B1648; B1629's addendum of 2026-10-09).** Two sentences above are B1629's as first banked, and its addendum sharpens both. The fraction of letters in runs of length ≥ k tends to (k + 1)/2^k and is within 2.4% of it at every n = 10 … 18; it is the limit, not the value at every length. "Not dynamical" holds in this scope: no datum the principle forces (the tick, the clock) and no expectation under the weave's uniform measure on threads of an observable in ever-deeper horoballs gives the cusp a non-zero weight; other measures and other dynamics are not excluded. The owner's tagging of the unit (v1.39) is the owner's ruling and stands in either reading. **[v1.40] Qualified (B1632, main's own computation):** the weave's topological lifts on T form only a projective representation of Mp2(Z). Among its genuine rescalings χ_{3/2} is 0 for five and 1 for one, so W45's zero (and with it the ±3 given the unit) holds for the multiplier the SM seat derived in W41 — the zero modes transforming by the topological action, T's exponents (⅛, ⅜, ⅞) — for which main reproduces χ_{3/2} = 0. W41's multiplier is registered, not yet verified on main; until it is, the payoff is "given Λ, the unit and W41". **[v1.41] Resolved (B1634, main):** the qualification above came from an instrument, not from the weave. The helper that lifts an automorphism takes the first of ±g, and for S̃ = R L⁻¹ R it took the sign opposite to the product of the move matrices. The move matrices themselves satisfy the braid relation exactly, and Δ⁴ acts on T as −1, so they are a genuine representation of B₃/⟨Δ⁸⟩ = Mp2(ℤ). With S = H₁(S̃) and T = H₁(L) (the lifts compose in reverse, so ρ(γ) = lift(γ)⁻¹), the relations hold with no rescaling, and the representation is exactly the multiplier of η²¹·(θ₂², θ₃², θ₄²) (a monomial intertwiner; θ₃² on the clock's line) — W41's multiplier, T's exponents (⅛, ⅜, ⅞). Its dual is not allowed at weight 3/2. χ_{3/2} = 0 by the formula and by an independent count (the modular forms of Γ(4) as polynomials in θ₂², θ₃², θ₄² modulo Jacobi's quadric, which agrees with the formula at every weight from −½ to 27/2). So the payoff is again "given Λ and the unit": W45's core is verified on main. The five-to-one split of v1.40 is the six flat twists by η's character (χ_{3/2} = 1 at one of them), W47's territory. **[v1.42] The hand (B1640): "no choice is made" is scoped.** ρ(γ) = lift(γ)⁻¹ is one of two homomorphisms the reverse-composing lifts give; the transpose is the other, and for these unitary lifts it is the complex conjugate. Which of V's two pieces is T is a second binary choice. Together they decide between the theta constants' multiplier and its conjugate. The record's choice allows weight 3/2 (W45's index) and the symmetric weight-1 coupling (B1636's golden coupling); the conjugate allows neither (at weight 1 its only coupling is antisymmetric). So the index and the golden coupling come with the same hand. Which hand the matter carries is not derived; a derivation from the zero modes' period map is owed. **[v1.43] W46 on main, and the two objects (B1641).** W46 is verified on main's own lifts: the six local solutions have exponents (⅛, ⅛, ⅜, ⅝, ⅞, ⅞) and split as irreducibles of dimension 2 and 4, every χ₁ = 0, χ_{3/2}(ρ_T) = 0, and the four-dimensional index is n(|Λ₊| − 3) — so "±3 given Λ and the unit" now rests on main. M₁,₂'s fibre loops are the inner automorphisms. The lift of them that agrees with the ruled moves at Δ⁴ = conj(a b⁻¹ a⁻¹ b) acts on T by the parity signs (and Δ⁴ by −1); the geometric lift, trivial on the fibre's cohomology, differs from the moves by the central sign there. So the surface of the index and the branch of the couplings are one object, and couplings obey a parity selection rule: a parity-blind Higgs allows only diagonal couplings, a Higgs carrying parity exactly the golden pattern (c(u, u, u) = 24η⁶). Neither ρ_T nor its conjugate is a sub or quotient of the six, so the hand is not the puncture condition's orientation at the representation level. **[v1.44] Scoped (Review 63, B1648).** The agreement with the ruled moves was checked at Δ⁴ alone; coherence of the lifts over all of Aut⁺(F₂) is the Banking Seat's Gate 12 (POINT_REGISTER P-074), still owed. **[v1.53] Closed since (B1678): kept with its coefficient action, the act lifts through the central double cover of Aut⁺(F₂) to one coherent action of the four wordings on matter and boundary (P-074); the joint image is reducible, so the extreme domain stays chosen.** "The two objects are one" takes the weave's surface to be M₁,₂, the SM seat's reading (W19, verified on main in part, B1624). The results built on this (B1642, B1644–B1646) carry both conditions. **[v1.52] The Higgs's end data are this unit (B1700).** The newest frame's cusp hierarchy (B1691, B1694–B1699) needs the Higgs to carry one unit of end data on v₊. That is the tagged unit used as the coupling triplet R uses it, not a second postulate. Given the unit (W46's uniform twist), the weight-3/2 sections of ρ_T = ρ_R form a three-dimensional space, W46's three. ∂R is its only member holomorphic off v₊ and the only one giving a hierarchy, so those results hold given Λ, the unit and H-cov in R's own module. **[v1.53] Four-dimensional gravity does not supply the unit (B1708, B1710; the SM seat's W120, W121; P-254).** The closed torus-fibred 4d vacua over the weave's τ-line close at 12χ(O_S) strings [v1.54: 12, 24, 36, …; v1.53 said 12 or 24], so their units of end data come in multiples of twelve. The triplet lives only where χ(O_S) is even (K3 the least), and its count there is −15χ(O_S) or −18χ(O_S) (−30 and −36 on K3), never three [v1.54: given the SM seat's reduction of the 4d Dirac index to Riemann–Roch on the base, which main did not re-derive (B1710)]. FK10's single unit at the weave's cusp stays a tagged postulate. **[v1.59] The unit reduced to the field's existence and three further links, none derived on the record (B1796; P-288).** B1796 verified on main the SM seat's W123 (its exact route; row 1301) and, of W130 (row 1309), the point's non-unitarity and Hitchin's equation; W130's images, other points, 'exactly one field', H3 and H4 stay the seat's, unverified on main. With m = (m_P, m_M, m_N) units of end data on the eigenlines P, M = v₊, N of ρ_T's T-matrix, the weight-3/2 forms of ρ_T have dimension max(0, m_P + m_M + m_N) on every vector computed; proved: 0 whenever Σm ≤ 0, and 3n for n ≥ 0 uniform units (O(nδ), W46's uniform twist). The least datum on one eigenline gives one dimension (on v₊ alone, ∂R; B1700); the least uniform datum gives three, the space whose index is W46's three (as does any datum with Σm = 3); that the Higgs direction and the chiral three's zero modes share this space is B1700's reading, not a claim. At a Fuchsian point of the fibre, such as (3, 3, 3) (the modular torus), the flat datum is not unitary, so its Higgs field is nowhere zero. So the unit follows from four links, none derived on the record: the field's existence (FK15; W130's 'forced' is PF1 read on the fibre's rest state, the seat's reading); the identification of the fibre's Higgs field (End E ⊗ K) with a weight-3/2 form of ρ_T; uniform end data; and the least remainder — given Λ and the hand (for the conjugate hand there is no weight-3/2 space at any end data). That the three are generations is FK11's (met conditionally, given Λ and the unit, v1.39). The tag stays: this is a reduction of the postulate, not a derivation.
identifier_rows.FK11: UNEARNED — **[v1.60] earnable BY PREDICTION within a frame (GAP1's v1.60 rule; the owner's ruling of 2026-11-03, B1828); by derivation:** **[v1.27] UNEARNABLE within F-HE and F-CI on any thread or cover of a thread (T-NO-INDEX-IN-THREE, B1604):** every twisted Euler characteristic on a cusped 3-manifold vanishes, so no count of flat-module cohomology there is an index with the physical shape identity n_5̄ = n_10; the class index is a difference of interior ranks in degrees one and two, governed by no characteristic class (B1603: eight kinds of reading on 442 classes). **[v1.46] (B1655)** Six kinds on certified covers, not eight (B1603's correction; B1605). B1604's theorem is that no twisted Euler characteristic, and not B1492's class index, carries n_5̄ = n_10 on a thread or a cover; "governed by no characteristic class" means that no formula I(Λ²E) = f(I(E)) fits the reliable data. Indices of other kinds (η-invariants, L²) are not addressed by it. What would earn a dictionary: an even-dimensional object the weave forces, carrying a non-flat bundle whose index is the count, or the orbifold standard read as what it is — a sector selected by a character, a selection
